faults.trigger: AC, GM20B, 0x000b000f, two-buffer SEQUENTIAL window, no application writes, first Present(1,0).
faults.cause: Unknown. On the matched candidate three independent boots ended abnormally. The last durable operation was the first Present. Event 41 reported bugcheck zero.
faults.daily_workaround: Keep this native Blt path out of daily launches. A client with a validated flip option may use the verified legacy FLIP_SEQUENTIAL route within its tested scope. The six-frame control matched 15 desktop samples. The WARP empty-window control is a separate software result.
faults.close_when: Identify the initiating failure and fix it. Retest the original legacy SEQUENTIAL trigger on AC at least three consecutive times, including correct visible output, normal exit and desktop continuity.

faults.trigger: Process-scoped WDDM 2.0 interface 0x000b0020, first empty Present on SEQUENTIAL or FLIP_SEQUENTIAL.
faults.cause: The runtime supplied Reserved=1 and the Present1 input guard returned E_INVALIDARG before the Windows callback. In the process-scoped candidate, the identical FLIP_SEQUENTIAL empty window reached the callback and returned S_OK. A one-clear window also returned S_OK and matched all five desktop samples. The other swap effect still needs candidate validation.
faults.daily_workaround: Keep the experimental WDDM 2.0 offer confined to a one-time diagnostic client. Use only application paths with independent physical acceptance for daily use.
faults.close_when: Verify actual rendering, on-screen output and normal exit through the affected system swap effects on three consecutive trials. Keep the legacy restart open until its own criteria pass.

faults.trigger: A six-frame native WDDM 2.0 window with external power and the process-scoped Present1 correction. Two frames returned successfully before an unexpected restart.
faults.cause: Unknown. The last durable application record entered the third Present. The captured DXGI trace ended 8.643 ms before that entry. Windows reported Kernel-Power 41 with bugcheck zero and event 6008, without a matching shutdown intent. The dump inventory was unchanged.
faults.daily_workaround: Keep multi-frame rendering through the process-scoped WDDM 2.0 candidate in diagnostics. The previous legacy FLIP_SEQUENTIAL six-frame control is qualified only for its measured client and scene.
faults.close_when: Identify and repair the initiating fault. Run the original multi-frame scene on external power at least three consecutive times with the tested components, verified display samples, normal exit and a continuous desktop.

faults.trigger: Intermittent desktop, game, video, exit or file-operation loads. Published observations have different trigger and power conditions.
faults.cause: Unknown. A common initiating failure across these observations has not been established.
faults.daily_workaround: Keep unqualified heavy-load paths in diagnostics. Use only a previously accepted alternative for the specific application and workload. No universal game or extraction workaround has been verified.
faults.close_when: Separate triggers with identified causes and document a fix and three consecutive original-scenario retests for each remaining restart.

faults.trigger: Wi-Fi driver failed to start on a boot reported by the operator, followed by a manual restart.
faults.cause: Startup cause unknown. The manual restart is documented separately from graphics resets.
faults.daily_workaround: Use confirmed working connectivity for remote operation. Keep startup reliability out of acceptance until it is tested.
faults.close_when: Identify the startup failure and qualify the corrected driver on repeated Windows boots with actual network access.

faults.trigger: Accepted ARM64 tgd3d 57dc16b4 on GM20B, legacy DXGI Blt1, sRGB source and UNORM destination. The identical test on optimal images changed all 88 pixels in a rectangular copy and all 748 interior pixels in a scaled channel conversion.
faults.cause: The unrotated path uses a Vulkan image blit that decodes sRGB channel values during conversion to UNORM. The signed candidate retained the encoded values on the same hardware and executable. The three logged empty sequential restarts used UNORM application buffers.
faults.daily_workaround: In a client that can choose its copy route, the accepted driver passed the measured one-to-one B8G8R8A8_UNORM copy between optimal surfaces. Keep sRGB-to-UNORM presentation copies in diagnostics for clients without a separately qualified option.
faults.close_when: On candidate components eligible for presentation promotion, repeat the original encoded-region and filtered-channel cases on AC in three consecutive runs. Verify pixel values, untouched borders, normal exit and the desktop. Record the adopted source, loaded component hashes and actual presentation output.
